text:
5 hours ago When 8 million people marched in “No Kings” protests, my Trump-supporting relatives asked me: Why? Many reasons. The rejection of the 2020 election loss, that was confirmed by numerous Trump-appointed judges. Contempt for the Constitution. The day after the Supreme Court rules Trump’s tariffs unconstitutional, he reimposes them. Corruption with billions flowing into crypto Trump family enterprises. Anyone ever give you a $400 million jet with no strings attached? Attacking reporters for honest questions. Attacking women reporters as “piggy.” The judgment in which he was found to have sexually assaulted Jean Carroll, along with the hidden Trump=Epstein files. Referring to anyone who votes against him as “an enemy of the people.” Constant racism demanding removal of exhibits on slavery from the Smithsonian museums and national landmarks. Cult of personality Cabinet meetings with incompetent unqualified lackeys who violate the first of the 10 Commandments in their worship of him. Using ICE as street thugs against American citizens. Dishonesty in demanding mid-decade state redistricting to create Trump rule over Congress. Trump wants to end mail-in voting to maintain power by limiting polling places for non-Trump neighborhoods. Supporting oil riches for Russia and Putin while pulling support from Ukraine. Trump places his own vice president in mortal danger with the violent Jan. 6 insurrection then told the mob attacking 140 Capital police officers he “loved” them. Read full article
